metadata.reference_highlights:
Joint Warrior is a massive, multi-nation military exercise held off Britain's coast
Russian military activity adds realism to the war games, which involve 13,000 personnel
Russia has repeatedly staged surprise military drills and flown bombers near NATO airspace
